item.title: about effective voltage and rms
item.description: Effective voltage of sinusoidal # In alternating current, to simplify the calculation, we often use effective voltage or current. Since I haven’t touched these knowledge points for a long time. I almost forgot how to get the effective voltage and what’s the relation of effective voltage with rms (root mean square). So this is about the derivation of effective voltage. Effective voltage is always used in calculating power or energy during a time.
